title: Validate collaboration record snapshots
responsibility: Define strict project and record schemas with identity, ownership and binding checks.

outputs.name: projectSchema
outputs.description: Strict project schema for UUID, name, repository identity, creation time and owner actor ID.

outputs.name: recordsSchema
outputs.description: Strict version-1 records schema for projects, members, invitations and threads; rejects duplicate identities or request IDs, unbound records and projects without an owner.
